# Stage I regression contracts

These are small expected-output records, not training data or trained weights.

- `training_arguments.json`: keyword arguments captured from the pre-refactor
  `model.train(...)` call. Machine-specific paths are normalized to `<run-root>`.
- `evaluation_arguments.json`: arguments captured from the pre-refactor
  `model.val(...)` call, with the same path normalization.
- `subset_selection.json`: ordered IDs, splits, boxes, normalized coordinates,
  exclusions and 32 review selections produced by the pre-refactor preparation
  code on the ZIP generated by `tests/stage1_fixtures.py`.

The original script was saved before editing and used for a one-time differential
comparison. Its source is not shipped as a second production implementation.
Tests compare the new modules against these records and also run preparation
again to check determinism. Deliberate future changes to the experiment definition
should be documented rather than silently updating fixtures to hide a regression.
